properties.name: agent4j.enabled
properties.description: Enable agent4j auto-configuration (ModelClient + AgentFactory). No singleton Agent bean is created.

properties.name: agent4j.model.provider
properties.description: Model client provider: openai (OpenAI-compatible HTTP) or mock (rule-based MockModelClient).

properties.name: agent4j.model.api-key
properties.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Ignored by the mock provider.

properties.name: agent4j.model.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible chat completions API.

properties.name: agent4j.model.name
properties.description: Default model name passed to OpenAiModelClient.

properties.name: agent4j.model.timeout
properties.description: Constructor timeout passed to OpenAiModelClient. Call-level timeout is agent4j.call-timeout.

properties.name: agent4j.retry.enabled
properties.description: Wrap the base ModelClient with RetryModelClient.

properties.name: agent4j.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Passed as RetryModelClient maxRetries (retries after the first attempt).

properties.name: agent4j.call-timeout.enabled
properties.description: Wrap the base ModelClient with TimeoutModelClient.

properties.name: agent4j.call-timeout.duration
properties.description: Max duration for a single model call when call-timeout is enabled.

values.description: Rule-based MockModelClient (no network, suitable for tests)
